weather_line: Overcast in the hollows · the Subcommittee blames the clouds

stories.headline: Subcommittee Assigns the Room an Eleven-Digit Reference Number; the Room Remains at Its Coordinates, Unmoved, Unnamed, Unbothered
stories.byline: By our Ministry correspondent, filing from the corridor outside Conference Room D
body: The Subcommittee on Unmapped Geographical Features convened an emergency Friday session and, in the absence of any reply from Christine, any confirmed coordinates, and any successful sighting of the spur by Cresswell's mapping party, voted four to one to assign the Room above Marker 9 the provisional reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19. The dissenting vote came from a junior clerk named Tibbs, who noted in the record that assigning a number to a location one has not visited is, quote, 'not really how numbers work.' Tibbs has been thanked for his contribution and reassigned to a different corridor.

The Subcommittee's chair, Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole, issued a statement describing the number as 'a placeholder pending field verification,' and requested, for the third time this week, that Christine attend a guided second expedition with Cresswell's party to 'ensure navigational continuity.' The Room, reached by our correspondent for comment, was not findable. Christine's reply to the third memo arrived at the Subcommittee at half past four: a single sentence, written in her clearest hand, which read: 'The Room does not require a number.' Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole has called a further session for Monday. Tibbs asked if he could come back.

stories.headline: Friday's Full Ledger Cleared by Noon; Griphook the Younger Personally Brings Christine a Cup of Tea, Says Nothing, Returns to His Desk
body: In what banking analysts are calling 'a significant development in goblin emotional expression,' Griphook the Younger set a cup of chamomile tea — properly brewed, not the Ministry-commissary variety — on Christine's desk at eleven forty-seven Friday morning and departed without speaking. Christine thanked him. He did not turn around. Sources inside the vault registry confirm this is the first unsolicited beverage Griphook the Younger has ever delivered to a non-goblin in the recorded history of Gringotts London.

The gesture followed a morning in which Christine resolved the Pendleton Estate Dispute, reconciled the Flint family's seventeen outstanding sub-accounts, and talked a first-time depositor down from what the intake forms describe only as 'a strongly held theoretical position about gold.' By noon, the Friday ledger was clear. The tea was still warm.

stories.headline: The Kitchen Table Reaches Maximum Capacity; Steve Proposes a Second Table; Christine Notes There Is Already a Second Table
body: The kitchen table — which has served, without complaint, as expedition command centre, bureaucratic intake tray, and archive for one survey sketch, three Subcommittee memos, and a duck — reached what Steve described Friday evening as 'a critical documentation threshold.' He proposed acquiring a second table. Christine pointed to the table in the next room, which has been there for four years. Steve examined it. He has no memory of it.

The sketch remains in its position. The duck has not moved. The most recent Subcommittee memo — the one proposing reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19 — arrived just before dinner and was placed on top of the others. Christine read it standing up, set it down, and made pasta. The table held everything without comment, as it always does.

stories.headline: Lucy Denies Knowledge of the Missing Memo Attachment; the Attachment Was Found; No Further Questions Are Being Taken at This Time
body: A four-page supplementary appendix, submitted by the Subcommittee alongside this morning's reference-number memo, went briefly missing between the owl drop and Christine's desk. It was recovered, slightly damp, behind the sofa. Lucy was in the garden at the time of recovery, having been in the garden, she wishes it known, for quite some while. She will not be elaborating.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has issued a formal statement confirming she was Outside when the appendix went missing, and further notes that Outside is a location, and a location is an alibi, and an alibi is a thing she has, and that concludes her remarks.

Ellie: Discovered this morning that the reference number on the Subcommittee memo is very long and contains both letters and numbers, which she found impressive, and then asked if 'RMX' was a name, and whether RMX would like to meet Jersey.

Jersey: Has identified the stack of memos as a structurally sound platform and has been napping on top of them since approximately two o'clock; regards the Subcommittee's filing system as among the more comfortable things to have arrived this week.
founding_editor_note: That Subcommittee couldn't find their way around a properly-framed doorway. I built a room once — I knew where it was, nobody had to number it. — D.

in_brief.sport: Friday's Personal Records Desk reports no new lifts logged, though Griphook the Younger's tea delivery has been entered as an uncontested victory in the Goodwill division.
in_brief.forecast: Overcast through the weekend; the spur remains exactly where it has always been; the Subcommittee will not find this helpful.

storyline_updates.title: The Subcommittee's Jurisdiction Problem
storyline_updates.summary: Day 3: The Subcommittee assigned the Room provisional reference number 00-441-GF-7703-RMX-19 without having visited it. Cresswell's mapping party still cannot locate the spur. Christine responded to the third memo with a single sentence — 'The Room does not require a number' — delivered at half past four Friday. Undersecretary Prentice-Hoole has called a further session for Monday. Junior clerk Tibbs, who voted against the number and was reassigned, has asked to be reinstated. Day 4 should be the resolution: Christine's patience has now fully taken the shape of a decision. She should either deliver a definitive closing statement that ends the Subcommittee's claim entirely — perhaps citing an obscure Gringotts precedent, or simply invoking the fact that the Room cannot be administered by people who cannot find it — or the Subcommittee should quietly, somewhat sheepishly, withdraw. Tibbs should be redeemed in some small, satisfying way.
